page.overview:
Who is Olav?

Olav is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. He is the grandson of Oimo.

Olav is a young boy with a large, round face. He wears a fur coat, a belt with a large, round buckle, and black gloves. Additionally, he has a large, uniquely-shaped helmet with two horns and a top piece resembling a Roman pluma.

Like other Walrus School students, Olav is against violence and fighting. Befittingly, he did not care for the Giant Warrior Pirates, considering them to be savages; this extends to even family, as he looked down on his grandfather for being a member. However, upon being rescued from the Knights of God, he was excited to watch the crew fight against the enemies.

Oimo is Olav's grandfather. Although Oimo cares greatly for Olav, his grandson has been shown to have a fairly low opinion of his grandfather and his crewmates. Despite this, he was greatly concerned when Oimo put his life on the line to rescue him.
